fat32format x64 helper for Win11Usb native review

Original: fat32format by Tom Thornhill / Ridgecrop Consultants Ltd.
License: GNU General Public License. The vendor source does not specify a
version. GPL version 2 text is supplied (COPYING.GPL-2.0.txt); Win11Usb changes
are licensed under GPL version 2 or later.
Original source archive: third_party/fat32format/fat32formatsrc-vendor.zip.

Modified by Win11Usb contributors on 2026-10-22:
- x64 build, no dependency on WOW64 or a managed runtime.
- accepts only an explicitly confirmed volume GUID plus disk/offset/length/sector.
- independently verifies that volume's physical extent before any write.
- removes the original drive-letter command interface and interactive prompt.
- checks partial writes, flushes output, fixes error exit and allocation handling.
- uses checked 64-bit sector seeks; rejects incomplete extent/geometry responses.
- requires the already-created MBR FAT32 type and matching hidden-sector offset;
  does not rewrite partition types after formatting.
- file-only tests reuse the production formatter for 8/64 GiB and 512/4096-byte
  sectors. Storage IOCTLs in those tests are replaced; they are not USB acceptance.
- opens with FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, then obtains FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME
  on the confirmed extent; retries only pre-write acquisition for up to 30 seconds.
  Open permission errors and extent mismatches stop without formatting. Tests
  cover actual file sharing conflicts, delayed acquisition and a no-write timeout.

This GPL program runs as a separate process. It is not linked into the MIT
application. Its executable, complete modified C source, original source ZIP,
license, and this notice are embedded as resources in the single distributable
EXE and extracted into the current task directory before use.

Build from the repository root, using llvm-mingw 20261020 msvcrt x86_64:
  native\build.cmd "C:\path\to\llvm-mingw\bin" full
Equivalent helper-only command:
  x86_64-w64-mingw32-clang.exe -O2 -static native/third_party/fat32format.c -o native/out/fat32format-x64.exe

No warranty. Back up data before formatting. The helper itself does not choose
devices, elevate, download code, modify security settings, or start a shell.
